svg.title: Calico Tea Garden — clickable paint-by-number
svg.desc: A seated calico with broad black, orange, and white coat islands in a sunny botanical tea nook. Click a numbered region to toggle its suggested color. Shift-click paints every region with the same number.
svg.metadata: {"slug": "calico-tea-garden", "title": "Calico Tea Garden", "desc": "A seated calico with broad black, orange, and white coat islands in a sunny botanical tea nook.", "tags": ["Calico Cat", "Floral", "Cozy", "OurSpace Original"], "palette": [{"hex": "#F6E7C5", "name": "Warm paper"}, {"hex": "#C97B63", "name": "Terracotta frame"}, {"hex": "#78967A", "name": "Garden sky"}, {"hex": "#E2B353", "name": "Sun gold"}, {"hex": "#D9A04A", "name": "Leaf ochre"}, {"hex": "#91604C", "name": "Clay"}, {"hex": "#A7B7A4", "name": "Pale sage"}, {"hex": "#E7A99A", "name": "Peach floor"}, {"hex": "#5A4741", "name": "Espresso rug"}, {"hex": "#D9C8A9", "name": "Sand rug"}, {"hex": "#7E9C8E", "name": "Sea-glass rug"}, {"hex": "#F5F0E5", "name": "Calico white"}, {"hex": "#3B312E", "name": "Deep brown"}, {"hex": "#242628", "name": "Calico black"}, {"hex": "#49433F", "name": "Charcoal"}, {"hex": "#D97832", "name": "Pumpkin orange"}, {"hex": "#E8A34A", "name": "Golden orange"}, {"hex": "#FFF9ED", "name": "Bright white"}, {"hex": "#8BA56F", "name": "Green-gold eyes"}, {"hex": "#202525", "name": "Pupils"}, {"hex": "#D58E88", "name": "Rose nose"}, {"hex": "#E7C5AA", "name": "Warm muzzle"}, {"hex": "#C6D8CC", "name": "Celadon pot"}, {"hex": "#6E4B44", "name": "Umber rim"}], "complexity": "Detailed"}
